meta.title: Compliance & Integrity — Dutex
meta.description: Dutex operates with zero tolerance for unethical conduct, harassment and discrimination. Learn about our integrity program.

hero.description: Dutex operates with zero tolerance for unethical conduct, harassment and discrimination. Our integrity program is a prerequisite for any commercial or employment relationship with the company.

pillars.title: Four foundations that guide our conduct

items.title: Zero Tolerance
items.description: No conduct involving moral harassment, sexual harassment or discrimination is tolerated — regardless of position, hierarchy or tenure.

items.title: Structured Process
items.description: All reports are investigated by an independent commission, with due process, full defense and a maximum 30-day resolution period.

items.title: Confidentiality and Protection
items.description: The reporter may choose anonymity. Any retaliation against victims or witnesses is treated as an independent offense and is punishable.

items.title: Full Scope
items.description: The program binds employees, third parties, suppliers and sales representatives. Adherence is mandatory and part of the contract.

legal.paragraph1: Dutex's Integrity Program is developed by specialized legal counsel and updated annually to reflect the evolution of Brazilian regulations.
legal.paragraph2: Suppliers and partners who work with us formally adhere to our ethical guidelines as a contractual condition — without exception.

cta.title: Want to qualify Dutex as a supplier?
cta.description: Request our credentials package — ISO 9001 + Compliance Program

items.question: Who can use Dutex's compliance channel?
items.answer: Employees, suppliers, partners, representatives and related stakeholders may use the official ethics channels.

items.question: Can reports be submitted anonymously?
items.answer: Yes. The reporting channel supports anonymous submissions and confidential handling, with anti-retaliation safeguards.

items.question: How long does an investigation take?
items.answer: Investigations follow a structured process with an independent committee and a maximum 30-day resolution timeline under internal policy.
